task.title: Valider un candidate Firefox policies.json via l’API
task.shortdesc: Use the validation endpoint as a preflight gate for candidate Firefox Enterprise policies.json documents and structured error handling.

prereq.p: Choose the target schema channel, such as release-152 or esr-140.12, and prepare a ValidationRequest body with a full Firefox document in document.policies.

context.p: This task covers API-VAL-001. BPM validates candidate policies.json content before import, export handoff, or an external policy-review gate. A plain policy mapping is still accepted for compatibility, but new integration examples use the full Firefox policies.json shape.

step.cmd: Submit a successful validation request for the selected schema channel.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with JSON {"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true,"BlockAboutConfig":true}}}. Response example: 200 {"ok":true,"profile":"release-152"}.

step.cmd: Treat ok=false as a failed gate even when HTTP status is 200.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with JSON {"document":123}. Response example: 200 {"ok":false,"profile":"release-152","detail":"Expected object with policy mappings","error":"Expected object with policy mappings"}. Check the response body, not HTTP status alone.

step.cmd: Handle malformed canonical Firefox document errors as request-shape failures.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with JSON {"document":{"policies":[]}}. Error example: 400 with detail.message="Firefox policies.json validation failed" and detail.issues[].path pointing to policies.

step.cmd: Reject unsupported schema channels before trusting validation results.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/beta-999 with JSON {"document":{"policies":{"DisableTelemetry":true}}}. Error example: 404 with detail text Unknown profile 'beta-999'. A registered but unavailable schema returns 503.

step.cmd: Map policy validation failures to actionable reviewer feedback.

info.p: Request example: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with JSON {"document":{"policies":{"Proxy":{"Mode":"bogus"}}}}. Error example: 422 with detail.message="Policy validation failed" and issue fields policy, path, and message.

step.cmd: Record the validation decision in the integrating product.

info.note: Validation is a schema and policy-shape gate only. It does not deploy Firefox, prove runtime enforcement, authenticate callers, reserve a profile revision, or provide an idempotency key. Store the channel, candidate document hash, response status, ok value, structured issues, and reviewer decision externally.

result.p: The integration can block unsafe candidate policies.json handoffs and preserve structured evidence for success and failure decisions.

postreq.p: If validation succeeds, continue to import, profile update, or export handoff using the same schema channel and recorded candidate hash.
